Test Description: Validates that a Base variant vehicle can be discovered via BLE and successfully initiates the enrollment sequence.
Validates that a Premium variant vehicle utilizes UWB for secure discovery and enrollment initiation.
Validates the end-to-end flow of provisioning a digital key from the mobile app through the cloud to the vehicle controller.
Measures the total time taken for the digital key enrollment process under nominal network conditions.
Validates that the Base mobile app correctly discovers eligible vehicles using standard BLE protocols.
Validates that the Premium app enforces on-device biometric authentication before allowing key provisioning.
Validates the Fleet cloud service's ability to process bulk CSV uploads for mass key provisioning.
Validates that unauthenticated users are blocked from initiating the digital key enrollment process.
Validates that a Base variant vehicle automatically unlocks when an authorized phone enters the BLE proximity zone.
Validates that a Premium variant vehicle securely unlocks using UWB precise ranging.
Validates the system's proximity policy engine correctly triggers actions when crossing defined boundaries.
Measures the end-to-end unlock latency for the Base variant using BLE RSSI over 50 runs.
Measures the secure ranging handshake latency for the Premium variant using UWB over 50 runs.
Validates that the Base vehicle controller unlocks specifically when BLE RSSI crosses the -64 dBm threshold.
Validates that the Premium UWB system successfully rejects a simulated BLE relay attack.
Test Objective: Verify Premium UWB relay attack prevention.

Test Description: Validates that the Fleet vehicle controller accepts and executes remote unlock commands via the Fleet API.
Validates that the vehicle controller immediately rejects unlock requests from unrecognized digital key identifiers.
Validates that an authorized rider with a valid key can successfully start the vehicle.
Validates that the system permits ride authorization only when the cryptographic key is valid.
Validates that the system rejects ride authorization attempts using a revoked digital key.
Measures the latency between the mobile app 'Start' command and the physical ignition relay closure.
Validates that the mobile app UI correctly displays the active ride authorization status to the rider.
Validates that the ignition remains disabled if the cryptographic challenge-response handshake fails or times out.
Test Objective: Verify crypto handshake failure blocks ignition.

Test Description: Validates that an authenticated vehicle owner can successfully create and distribute a shared digital key.
Validates that a shared digital key strictly enforces the constraints (e.g., permissions) assigned by the owner.
Validates that a Base variant shared key correctly expires and fails authentication after the configured time window.
Validates that a Premium variant shared key fails authentication if used outside the defined geofencing zone.
Validates that the mobile app correctly renders a list of all active shared keys and their specific constraints.
Validates that an owner can successfully revoke an active shared digital key via the mobile app.
Validates that a revocation command successfully propagates from the cloud to the vehicle controller.
Measures the time taken for a revocation command to propagate from the cloud to the vehicle controller.
Validates the Fleet API's ability to process bulk revocation requests for up to 1,000 keys simultaneously.
Validates that the Premium mobile app allows an owner to configure and save a specific time-window restriction.
Validates that the cloud policy engine correctly denies ride authorization when attempted outside a configured time window.
Test Objective: Verify policy engine denies outside window.

Test Description: Validates the functionality of the time-picker UI component within the Premium mobile application.
Validates that the Fleet Dashboard correctly assigns shift-based profiles and restricts rider access accordingly.
Validates that an owner can successfully generate a temporary valet or service key.
Validates that a valet key correctly masks permissions, rejecting any owner-level actions.
Validates that the Base vehicle controller enforces a 20km/h speed limit when a valet key is active.
Validates that the Premium vehicle controller disables the trunk release mechanism when a valet key is active.
Validates that the system correctly logs a security event when an unknown key attempts to unlock the vehicle.
Validates that unauthorized users receive a 403 Forbidden error when attempting to access security event logs.
Test Objective: Verify unauthorized user cannot read logs.
Pre-conditions: User B requests User A logs.

Test Description: Validates that multiple failed authentication attempts generate distinct, timestamped log events.
Validates that the Base variant cloud database enforces a 1-year retention policy for security logs.
Validates that the Premium variant Data Lake enforces a 5-year immutable (WORM) retention policy.
Validates that the Fleet variant correctly streams security events to an external SIEM via webhook.
Validates that the mobile app correctly displays the current lock state of the vehicle.
Validates that the system successfully synchronizes telemetry data from the vehicle to the mobile app.
Validates that the Base app updates the lock state UI via standard REST polling within 60 seconds.
Validates that the Premium app receives and displays real-time lock state updates via WebSockets.
Validates that the Fleet Dashboard can handle and render real-time telemetry updates for 10,000 simulated vehicles.
Validates that the vehicle permits ride authorization during the offline grace period.
Validates that the vehicle rejects ride authorization once the offline grace period has expired.
Test Objective: Verify offline grace rejects after expiry.

Test Description: Validates that the vehicle's local authorization cache survives a complete power cycle.
Test Objective: Verify local cache survives power cycle.

Test Description: Validates the strict 72-hour hard limit for the offline grace mode.
Validates the hard timeout logic that strictly terminates offline grace mode.
Validates that all API and cross-service communication strictly enforces TLS 1.3 encryption.
Validates that sensitive data stored in databases and object storage is encrypted using AES-256.
Validates that no hardcoded secrets exist in the source code or environment variables.
Validates that the CI/CD pipeline automatically blocks deployment if container vulnerabilities are detected.
Validates that user data for EU residents is strictly routed and stored in the Frankfurt region.
Validates that US users can successfully toggle the CCPA 'Opt-Out of Sale' mechanism.
Validates that the 'Right to be Forgotten' API permanently purges all user PII from the database.
Validates that the mobile app correctly respects user consent toggles for data collection in real-time.
Validates that the Data Portability API successfully exports all user data in a machine-readable JSON format.
Validates that the API Gateway enforces a rate limit of 100 requests per minute per user.
Validates that read-heavy telemetry queries are correctly offloaded to database read replicas.
Validates that static mobile app assets are served from the nearest global CDN edge location.
Validates that core platform services are deployed across multiple Availability Zones.
Validates that the database can be successfully restored to a specific point in time after simulated corruption.
Validates that the mobile app gracefully degrades and queues actions when cloud connectivity is lost.
Validates that application logs generated in microservices appear in the centralized logging dashboard.
Validates that automated alerts are triggered when API error rates exceed the 1% threshold.
Validates that distributed tracing correctly propagates trace IDs across all downstream services.
Validates that telemetry records older than 90 days are automatically moved to cold storage.
Validates that time-based operations are stored in UTC and correctly converted to local timezones.
Validates that all API JSON responses strictly adhere to ISO 8601 date and time formatting.
Validates that the mobile app UI dynamically updates to Japanese when the device OS language is changed.
Validates that the mobile application and web dashboards meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
